verdict.rationale: Puzzle supports Classes with Groups (puzzle-docs-36) and general ledger/financial statement export in cash or accrual basis (puzzle-docs-26/37/45), plus multi-entity management (puzzle-docs-38/44), but there is no direct evidence of a custom report builder that lets accountants filter/group specifically by class, location, or tag dimensions together. missing for 10: explicit custom report builder UI, evidence of 'location' and 'tag' dimensions (only 'class' is documented), and confirmation that reports can be filtered/grouped by these dimensions simultaneously.
